doc.brief: The QTableWidgetItem class provides an item for use with the [QTableWidget](xref:qt:QTableWidget) class.
doc.index_brief: Item for use with the QTableWidget class

QBrush background() const.brief: Returns the brush used to render the item's background.

QBrush foreground() const.brief: Returns the brush used to render the item's foreground (e.g. text).

QDataStream & operator<<(QDataStream &ou.brief: Writes the table widget item *item* to stream *out*.

QDataStream & operator>>(QDataStream &in.brief: Reads a table widget item from stream *in* into *item*.

QFont font() const.brief: Returns the font used to render the item's text.

QSize sizeHint() const.brief: Returns the size hint set for the table item.

QTableWidget * tableWidget() const.brief: Returns the table widget that contains the item.

QTableWidgetItem * clone() const.brief: Creates a copy of the item.

QTableWidgetItem(const QIcon &icon, cons.brief: Constructs a table item with the given *icon* and *text*.

QTableWidgetItem(const QString &text, in.brief: Constructs a table item with the given *text*.

QTableWidgetItem(int type).brief: Constructs a table item of the specified *type* that does not belong to any table.

QVariant data(int role) const.brief: Returns the item's data for the given *role*.

Qt::CheckState checkState() const.brief: Returns the checked state of the table item.

Qt::ItemFlags flags() const.brief: Returns the flags used to describe the item.

bool isSelected() const.brief: Returns `true` if the item is selected, otherwise returns `false`.

bool operator<(const QTableWidgetItem &o.brief: Returns `true` if the item is less than the *other* item; otherwise returns false.

int column() const.brief: Returns the column of the item in the table.

int row() const.brief: Returns the row of the item in the table.

int textAlignment() const.brief: Returns the text alignment for the item's text.

int type() const.brief: Returns the type passed to the [QTableWidgetItem](xref:qt:QTableWidgetItem) constructor.

void setBackground(const QBrush &brush).brief: Sets the item's background brush to the specified *brush*.

void setCheckState(Qt::CheckState state).brief: Sets the check state of the table item to be *state*.

void setData(int role, const QVariant &v.brief: Sets the item's data for the given *role* to the specified *value*.

void setFlags(Qt::ItemFlags flags).brief: Sets the flags for the item to the given *flags*.

void setFont(const QFont &font).brief: Sets the font used to display the item's text to the given *font*.

void setForeground(const QBrush &brush).brief: Sets the item's foreground brush to the specified *brush*.

void setIcon(const QIcon &icon).brief: Sets the item's icon to the *icon* specified.

void setSelected(bool select).brief: Sets the selected state of the item to *select*.

void setSizeHint(const QSize &size).brief: Sets the size hint for the table item to be *size*.

void setStatusTip(const QString &statusT.brief: Sets the status tip for the table item to the text specified by *statusTip*.

void setText(const QString &text).brief: Sets the item's text to the *text* specified.

void setTextAlignment(Qt::Alignment alig.brief: Sets the text alignment for the item's text to the *alignment* specified.

void setToolTip(const QString &toolTip).brief: Sets the item's tooltip to the string specified by *toolTip*.

void setWhatsThis(const QString &whatsTh.brief: Sets the item's "What's This?" help to the string specified by *whatsThis*.
